needed.suggestion: Create a narrow footway along the left side to provide a safe path for pedestrians.
Construct a footway on the right side to ensure pedestrians have a safe route parallel to the road.
Install a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the street to enable a safe crossing despite the absence of a formal crossing facility.
Create a central pedestrian refuge island to allow safe crossing in this narrow street despite the lack of a formal crossing.
Install dropped kerbs at the crossing point to facilitate easier access for pedestrians using the refuge island.
Install streetlights at the crossing area to enhance visibility for pedestrians using the refuge island and any informal path.
